decision: CLEAR for the bounded shared Menu disabled-reason implementation and authorized title-padding repair. No actionable findings remain in the reviewed increment. This is not application, architecture, or full product parity acceptance.

prior_findings.evidence: item_reason filters disabled/nonempty text before status_reason applies pointed-then-highlighted fallback. Original public runtime probe source is unchanged and changes RED on c78e to GREEN on 89fcb. Author public test additionally covers empty-reason fallback.

Disabled rows no longer derive HOVERED or PRESSED. Original held-row full-Cell probe changes RED on c78e to GREEN on 89fcb. New independent custom-recipe test checks that explicit hover/press rules do not leak through disabled state. Author native test verifies rest/hover/held/drag/release full row equality in all four profiles. This intentionally repairs an inherited candidate defect rather than claiming unchanged disabled-pointer frames.

supersedes.scope: Closes both previous actionable findings for this corrected source; preserves previous evidence and its rejected fixture analysis.

checks.scope: Both unchanged original regression functions, custom recipe precedence, default paired cell capture, and default press-before-release behavior.

520 independent consumer configurations: four profiles, widths 0..12, heights 0..4, empty or all-disabled Unicode data; Home/End/Up/Down/Enter/Space and pointer operations where addressable; no panic or chosen action.

default_compatibility.result: 32 full Cell-field event snapshots identical byte for byte
default_compatibility.intentional_difference: Disabled hover and held-press frames change to inert appearance; unchanged-frame claim only covers the recorded enabled interactions and ordinary default content.
default_compatibility.limits: Cell fields only; no cursor/terminal mode or all application flow parity claim.

source_review.public_API: MenuItem and MenuState fields remain private; borrowed reason uses existing lifetime, additive const builders/getter; action enums and existing signatures unchanged.
source_review.state_ownership: MenuState owns navigation/hover suppression/reason selection; no caller repaint or fake control. Disabled items retain reasons independently of hints/chords and cannot activate.
source_review.theme: The complete 6841..89fcb theme diff is one MENU DEFAULT HELP muted recipe line; no global palette, other family, or scalar changes.
source_review.override_precedence: Existing HELP part patch and slot tests remain green; custom MENU ROW HOVERED/PRESSED recipe cannot override disabled inert state because those flags are withheld. Disabled keyboard ACTIVE remains separate from transient press.
source_review.frozen_contract: Frozen menu assigns disabled state before RowUi resolution and excludes disabled release-activation targets; scoped correction follows that responsibility without claiming exact frozen cell colors.
source_review.title_padding: Authorized d148 repair restores label painting through the inset rect; existing title-padding native regression passes.
source_review.foreign_source: e4eae58e1b105f51d8e2ed7f580885498397ff2a is not an ancestor of reviewed source; no foreign e4 changes merged into this review copy.
source_review.safety: No unsafe code, new dependencies, baseline changes, replay mechanism, application edits, extra input/rendering system, or component ownership violation introduced in reviewed diff.

remaining_limits: No real pinned CLI Capsule adoption or paired baseline/candidate capture was performed.
Existing resize/reanchor and overflow contracts remain outside this increment; no general Menu lifecycle or pure-layout approval.
Full overlay-stack/cursor/focus restoration and arbitrary dynamic data interleavings were not exhaustively independently proven.
No full workspace Nextest/Clippy, hosted CI, Showcase capability adoption, or application/library final acceptance claimed.
